svg.title: Exhibit 03 — Modular Terraform
svg.desc: A module-per-service Terraform layout with remote state in S3. The Lambda module is built (IAM execution role, packaged source, environment); API Gateway, EC2 and MemoryDB modules are scaffolded. Illustrated with an animated schematic. Repository: github.com/Anup-Narkhede/terraform-project-an.
svg.text: lambda module: IAM role · archive_file · source hash · S3 state, native lockfile
